paper.title_en: Black Holes are about Quantum Information
paper.abstract_en: We review and analyse quantum information-theoretic approaches to black hole evaporation that purport to bring us closer to a resolution of the black hole information paradox. Our focus is on the Page-time paradox and on the contribution of the Hayden-Preskill model to understanding information release under the assumption of unitary evaporation. In this model, the black hole is taken to be a finite-dimensional quantum system whose dynamics can be represented by a quantum circuit, and its information-processing and communication abilities are studied. We identify the assumptions underlying this modelling and highlight two key features, fast scrambling dynamics and entanglement as a resource, that underpin the information release in the model. We argue that this reasoning exemplifies a broader change in how information is used in black hole physics, in which quantum information theory now provides a useful operational modelling framework. This application avoids earlier philosophical objections insofar as it is not based on epistemic ignorance and does not regard information as a substance. This line of reasoning has become central to the debate and, as such, warrants greater attention from the philosophy of physics community.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文从量子信息论视角综述黑洞蒸发与Page时间悖论，梳理Hayden-Preskill模型的假设（有限维量子系统、量子电路表示、快速扰动、纠缠作为资源），并讨论其哲学意义。属于黑洞信息悖论与引力基础方向的综述性分析，理论深度较高，对关注信息悖论基础问题的研究者有参考价值。
decision.abstract_zh: 我们回顾并分析了旨在使我们在黑洞信息悖论的解决上更进一步的黑洞蒸发的量子信息论方法。我们的关注点在于Page时间悖论，以及Hayden-Preskill模型在假定幺正蒸发的前提下对理解信息释放所做的贡献。在该模型中，黑洞被视为一个有限维量子系统，其动力学可由量子电路表示，并研究其信息处理与通信能力。我们识别出这一建模所依赖的假设，并强调支撑该模型中信息释放的两个关键特征：快速扰动动力学与作为资源的纠缠。我们认为，这一推理体现了信息在黑洞物理中被使用方式的更广泛转变，即量子信息论如今提供了一个有用的操作性建模框架。这一应用避免了早期的哲学异议，因为它并不基于认知上的无知，也不把信息视为一种实体。这一推理路线已成为该争论的核心，因此值得物理学哲学界给予更多关注。
